name: Artificial Analysis API performance method
description: Published API measurement protocol, separate from Intelligence Index scoring and from permission to reuse provider results. This is a source-only capability proposal. No evaluation, dataset admission, model/data permission, price quote or deployment gate is established. See research/T6-deployment-operations/evaluation.md.

provenance.notes: The page identifies method 2.2.0 and defines the three named measurements. Online denotes its repeated live-endpoint probes, not an installed observability product. Workload, concurrency, tokenizer, reasoning visibility, geography and measurement window affect comparison; unknown measurements or cost remain unknown. TTFT can include reasoning before answer tokens. No request was sent to a model or benchmark endpoint.
